answer_1.quote: We simulate multi-turn interactions and observe agents' social intelligence...
answer_1.outputs: Generated multi-turn dialogues and responses to multiple-choice questions for implicit reasoning.

answer_2.quote: We then calculate the average accuracy (Acc) of the current agent on these questions to determine the agent's score in information reasoning... We compute the standard deviation (std) of goal/information metrics... calculated as PSI.

answer_3.quote: We select GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72b, and Llama-3-70b from different model families as our judge models... We prompt third-party models with the chat history and ask if an agent has achieved his/her own social goals.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation for the rest 7.4% abnormal scenarios... We randomly sample 100 simulated scenarios... and manually verify whether the communication history shows that the goals were achieved.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators verify goal achievement based on communication history.
